task: Proactively emit the waveform peaks sidecar at chapter render finalization (render-time hook only, no back-catalog backfill); consolidate the sidecar cache format into one shared implementation

app/engines/audio_ops.py.summary: Added top-level imports json/logging/os and a module logger. New public helpers built around the existing compute_peaks_sidecar: peaks_sidecar_path(wav_path) -> Path (sibling .peaks.json), ensure_peaks_sidecar(wav_path, sidecar_path=None) -> dict | None (single owner of the sidecar cache format: stat wav -> freshness check -> compute-on-miss -> best-effort atomic write; never raises past compute's None contract; not internally locked). Plus internal _read_fresh_sidecar(sidecar_path, stat) -> dict | None (version/size/mtime freshness check) and _atomic_write_sidecar(sidecar_path, sidecar) (write .json.tmp -> os.replace, OSError logged+swallowed). These extract the freshness+write logic that previously lived only inside chapters_assets._load_or_compute_peaks_sidecar so there is now ONE implementation shared by the GET route and the render hook.

app/api/routers/chapters_assets.py.summary: _load_or_compute_peaks_sidecar refactored to delegate to the shared audio_ops.ensure_peaks_sidecar. Behavior identical: keeps the lock-free fast path (stat + _read_fresh_sidecar) and the per-WAV-path lock, but the in-lock compute+write is now the shared helper instead of an inline second copy. Import changed from (compute_peaks_sidecar, SIDECAR_VERSION) to (_read_fresh_sidecar, ensure_peaks_sidecar); removed now-unused `json` import and local freshness/atomic-write code. GET .../assets/peaks response shape and 404/degradation semantics unchanged.

app/orchestration/scheduler/orchestrator.summary: New method TaskOrchestrator._emit_chapter_peaks_sidecar(context) called from submit() immediately after the terminal 'completed' publish. Engine-agnostic finalization hook: gated on context.task_type == 'synthesis' AND payload.scope == 'chapter' AND output_path ending in .wav, so it covers both the XTTS remote path and the local mixed path with NO engine-id branch, and excludes segment re-renders (scope 'job') and the assembly m4b (different task_type). Best-effort/non-blocking: whole body wrapped in try/except that logs+swallows; lazily imports app.engines.audio_ops.ensure_peaks_sidecar (# noqa: PLC0415) to avoid import-time side effects. Does not backfill existing chapters.

tests/orchestration/test_peaks_emission_.summary: New test module for the render-time emission hook. Covers: emit-on-completed-chapter writes .peaks.json (R1 revert-checked red on pre-hook code); compute returning None does not fail the render; compute raising does not fail the render; segment job (scope 'job') skips emission; failed render skips emission. Mocks only app.engines.audio_ops.compute_peaks_sidecar (ffmpeg boundary, R2).

tests/api/test_peaks_asset_route.py.summary: GET-route peaks tests updated to point their boundary mocks at the new single implementation: compute_peaks_sidecar and os.replace are now monkeypatched on app.engines.audio_ops (added `audio_ops as audio_ops_module` import) instead of the chapters_assets module, reflecting that the cache format now lives in audio_ops. Assertions and route exercises unchanged.

flow_impact: The peaks-sidecar producer flow gains a second, proactive path: chapter renders now emit the sidecar at TaskOrchestrator.submit()'s universal completion point (previously the sidecar was produced ONLY lazily by the GET .../assets/peaks route). Both paths now share one implementation (audio_ops.ensure_peaks_sidecar) of the freshness-check + atomic-write cache format. The GET route remains the fallback for the back-catalog and any render whose best-effort emission failed. Documented in design-docs/specs/audio-player.md 1.6.8 (§5.4).
